d:
Navanbar ka aadha mahina bit chuka hai, lekin bihar men abhi bhi din ke samay garmi ka ehsas ho raha hai. vahin, subah aur sham halki thand parne lagi hai. aise men saval hai ki kya bihar men ab thand barhne vali hai? 16 navanbar ko kin jilon men kohra chhaega aur kahan tapman 30 digri ke par rahega? mausam vibhag ne agle sat dinon ka purvanuman jari kiya hai. aaie jante hain bihar ke mausam ka pura hal.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
